facts.fact: The Sudan Ministry of Finance, the AfDB and IGAD launched the national component of a regional entrepreneurship project (about US$3.255 million) implemented on the ground through the University of Khartoum's Entrepreneurship Incubator Center, with the implementation guide and work plan still to be approved.
